assertions.assertion: The denial was issued under reason code CO-22.
The claim/case relates to episode identifier ep-05161.
A clinical indication note exists documenting the patient's presentation.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness.
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
The note documents a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
The history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks is consistent with diagnosis code G45.9.
The note states prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to correlate cardiac rhythm disturbances with the neurological symptoms and dizziness.
CPT 93229 corresponds to mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring.
The service under CPT 93229 is medically necessary.
There is an outstanding balance of 427.50.
An appeal/reprocessing request is being made on this claim.
